label: The script skeleton
subgoals: Convert the design to an AIG with strash
Load a library with read_lib before standard-cell mapping
Map with if, map or amap and report with print_stats or stime

label: Which mapper does what
subgoals: Use if for LUT mapping with priority cuts
Use map for delay-oriented and amap for area-oriented standard-cell mapping
Add dch before mapping and mfs or lutpack after it

label: Checking and finishing the result
subgoals: Run cec between the original and mapped networks
Report timing with stime and resize with upsize and dnsize
Hold inputs fixed when comparing two scripts
